maya: tagging owners — sam + anita? this looks like a quant bring-up regression but high convo failures. assigning initial severity P2.
sam: looking. quick Q: did nightly use the new kernel patch (attn-fusion v2)?
leo: yes the infra rollout included attn-fusion v2 on the q4 hosts last night (deploy_bot: deploy 2026-04-02 00:50Z). could be kernel+quant interaction.
anita: can we get a minimal sample set? want the failing example ids to run locally. also need fp16 vs q4 diffs.
sam: grabbing samples now. re-running instruct-qa subset against both variants.
sam: command i'll run: `evalctl run --suite instruct-qa --limit 120 --models redwood-neo-3b-q4,redwood-neo-3b-fp16 --save diff.tar.gz`
ci-bot: Re-run queued: eval-id 1807502612 (owner: sam). Estimated completion 10m.
leo: ops note: we've seen a memory packing change on q4 nodes; if re-run still fails, we should try pinning to old kernel on one host for bisect.
manual note by maya: owners = sam (quant+eval), anita (eval analysis), leo (infra/serving). please post first 5 failing prompts in thread when available.
sam: first 5 IDs -> [f1234, f1235, f1240, f1241, f1256] (pasted samples to the eval artifacts link).
anita: initial eyeball: failures look like truncation + answer collapse on multi-turn prompts. will diff logits and token probs next.
ops-bot: Fallback policy check: dedicated routes are configured to fallback to fp16 variant if 20%+ degradation for 5m. current window below threshold; no auto-fallback triggered.
maya: ok keep P2 for now. sam/anita please post ETA for initial root-cause & whether rollback/fallback recommended.
sam: ETA ~45m for first pass local diffs, will update here.
anita: I'll prepare a focused eval (20 samples) with debug logging to collect logits.
leo: if we confirm kernel interaction, I'll coordinate a canary rollback on q4 hosts.
maya: thanks — appreciate quick turnaround. ping me if anything spikes to P1.
